abstract: A wide-band television switching system has been produced by using standard techniques but incorporating a distribution amplifier that was designed to be used as both an input and an output amplifier capable of a bandwidth of more than 17 mc. The requirements also necessitated the design of a small, very low-capacity relay which is an integral part of the overall system.
